persistence.limitation: The deployed repository seed is project-owned. Unlocked edits save directly in this browser; shared multi-user persistence requires an authenticated project write path that is not available in this static Vercel project.

masterRagThresholds.red: Inside 2% AEP (1-in-50 annual chance) flood extent.
masterRagThresholds.amber: Not Red and inside 1% AEP (1-in-100 annual chance) flood extent.
masterRagThresholds.green: Outside the Red and Amber extents with sufficient valid model coverage.
masterRagThresholds.grey: Required threshold model, coverage or point result cannot be evaluated.

masterRagThresholds.red: High/highest class, or inside an applicable unclassified hazard polygon.
masterRagThresholds.green: Low/Very Low class, or outside mapped polygons with valid coverage.
masterRagThresholds.grey: Site class, polygon coverage or point result cannot be evaluated.

masterRagThresholds.red: High/Very High or highest equivalent susceptibility.
masterRagThresholds.green: Low/Very Low/Unlikely category, or outside valid mapped susceptibility coverage.
masterRagThresholds.grey: No site-evaluable classification, source gap or an Undetermined result.

masterRagThresholds.red: Inside the configured authoritative mapped inundation or evacuation zone.
masterRagThresholds.amber: No Amber threshold configured unless the source supplies a meaningful secondary zone.
masterRagThresholds.green: Outside the configured zone with valid mapped coverage.
masterRagThresholds.grey: Point-level mapped coverage or result cannot be reproduced.

masterRagThresholds.red: Inside the configured current or higher-likelihood likely erosion extent.
masterRagThresholds.amber: Not Red and inside the configured later-horizon or lower-likelihood extent.
masterRagThresholds.green: Outside all configured erosion extents with valid model coverage.
masterRagThresholds.grey: Site-evaluable erosion model, scenario mapping, coverage or result is unavailable.

masterRagThresholds.red: Inside the configured current/near-term frequent planning or design scenario.
masterRagThresholds.amber: Not Red and inside the configured future, higher-sensitivity or 1% AEP secondary scenario.
masterRagThresholds.green: Outside the configured Red and Amber extents with valid mapped coverage.
masterRagThresholds.grey: Site-evaluable scenario, coverage or point result is unavailable.

masterRagThresholds.red: Inside a published high-resolution Fault Avoidance Zone (FAZ).
masterRagThresholds.amber: Inside a high-resolution Fault Awareness Area (FAA), but not a FAZ.
masterRagThresholds.green: Outside FAZ and FAA where high-resolution coverage exists.
masterRagThresholds.grey: Only regional 1:250,000 data is available, high-resolution coverage is absent, or the site result is not defensible.

versionHistory.summary: Initial configurable RAG rules, objective completeness requirements and five-site published seed.
Added Coromandel / TCDC as a configuration-led second-region proof with three verified SLSNZ locations and explicit evidence gaps.
Added direct regional portfolio switching, corrected the three TCDC clubhouse points, connected TCDC coastal and stormwater coverage evidence, and made regional map fitting deterministic.
Consolidated region state, reconciled coastal and TCDC evidence, simplified direct configuration editing, and aligned site and hazard-filtered reports.
Activated defensible Coromandel point-screening results, made remaining Grey reasons precise, and fixed mobile hazard-card status pills.
Separated one shared Master RAG Thresholds policy from Regional Data Mapping and re-evaluated every site through the shared prototype defaults.
